title: Rank of a finite flat morphism: locally constant, stable under base change, rank one means isomorphism
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] (for instance finite etale). For $s\in S$ let $r_f(s)\in\mathbf Z_{\ge0}$ be the rank of $f_*\mathcal O_X$ at $s$, i.e. the rank of the finite free $\mathcal O_{S,s}$-module $(f_*\mathcal O_X)_s$, equivalently $\dim_{\kappa(s)}\Gamma(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$. Then: (1) $r_f:S\to\mathbf Z_{\ge0}$ is locally constant, so each $r_f^{-1}(d)$ is open and closed in $S$; (2) for every morphism $g:S'\to S$ and the base change $f':X\times_SS'\to S'$ [def-pc-base-change], $r_{f'}(s')=r_f(g(s'))$ for all $s'\in S'$; (3) $f$ is an isomorphism if and only if $r_f(s)=1$ for every $s\in S$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 04MH (lemma-finite-locally-free: S = coprod S_d by open and closed S_d over which f has degree d), and the discussion after Definition 0AAZ (morphisms.tex, line 13546: finite locally free of degree 1 is an isomorphism); the base-change compatibility of the rank is the base change of the finite locally free module f_*O_X
